Name: Ribelle's NPC Portraits
Author: RibelleF
Description:
[font=宋体]一直很想看看自己的画风出现在游戏里会是什么样子所以画了一套[/font][font=Calibri]NPC[/font][font=宋体]头像。一开始只是想画可攻略[/font][font=Calibri]NPC[/font][font=宋体]，结果强迫症犯了于是结果画了所有人，包括泳装和冬装。可攻略[/font][font=Calibri]NPC[/font][font=宋体]的精度要显著高一点，这个也是没有办法的事情，毕竟我两个星期一边上班一边画了[/font][font=Calibri]111[/font][font=宋体]张图。[/font]
 
[font=Calibri]I[/font]’[font=Calibri]ve always wanted to see my arts show up in a game so I drew all NPC[/font]’[font=Calibri]s portraits, including winter outfits and some of their swimsuits. Marriageable characters are obviously more delicate, don[/font]’[font=Calibri]t judge me, I drew 111 arts in 2 weeks and have work to do.[/font]
 
[font=宋体]本[/font][font=Calibri]mod[/font][font=宋体]需要安装[/font][font=Calibri][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/font][font=宋体]、[/font][font=Calibri][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/font][font=宋体]以及[/font][font=Calibri][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/font][font=宋体]。下载之后解压，将包含全部[/font][font=Calibri]PNG[/font][font=宋体]的文件夹拖到[/font][font=Calibri][b]Mods-Portraiture-Protraits[/b][/font][font=宋体]里面，在游戏里按[/font][font=Calibri][b]P[/b][/font][font=宋体]切换进行显示。[/font]
 
[font=Calibri]This mod needs [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]. After downloading this mod, dispatch it and drag the folder with all PNG files into [b]Mods-Portraiture-Protrait[/b]s, press [/font]“[font=Calibri][b]P[/b][/font]” [font=Calibri]to show them in game.[/font]
 
我不太想对原作里的人物神态有太多修改（阿比盖尔的惊吓表情太可爱了），于是大多还是以原先头像的表情为基准；但有的角色和行走小人的配色或长相有些区别（比如伊芙琳和乔迪），我会选择以小人为准。
 
[font=Calibri]I don[/font]’[font=Calibri]t wanna change too much of npc[/font]’[font=Calibri]s original impression (Abigail[/font]’[font=Calibri]s shocked face is so cute omg), so most of them are based on the original portraits. But when it comes to some characters that are quite different from the walking model, like Evelyn and Jodi, I would chose to use their models for reference.[/font]
 
[font=宋体]画到一半有些无聊所以塞了几个彩蛋：蜗牛教授换成了丁丁历险记的向日葵教授，爷爷换成了火纹的罗德利古，黑帽子墨镜门卫男换成了老白，以及会说话的熊换成了哈尔辛。如果你不喜欢我整的活，或者我画的其他什么别的[/font][font=Calibri]NPC[/font][font=宋体]，直接把文件夹里的对应角色删掉就好，还是会显示游戏本来的立绘。[/font]
 
[font=Calibri]I got bored when drawing them so I put a few cameos in it. Professor Snail became Professor Tournesol from TINTIN, Grandpa become Rodrigue from FE3H (don[/font]’[font=Calibri]t ask, the guy hardly got chance to die peacefully), the Bouncer became Walter White from BB and the Bear became Halsin from BG3. If you don[/font]’[font=Calibri]t like them or frankly any other characters I draw, just delete the file from my folder.[/font]
 
[font=Calibri]Mod[/font][font=宋体]完全是出于娱乐制作免费分享，随便下载使用当头像印刷当无料都无所谓，不要商用就可以。如果真的想表示感谢，欢迎来我微博[/font][font=Calibri]@[/font][font=宋体]大蓝章鱼 支持我家产品，因为求你了[/font][font=Calibri].jpg[/font]
 
[font=Calibri]This mod is completely for fun and free. Use it however you like, as avatars or print them, I don[/font]’[font=Calibri]t care, as long as not for profit. If you really wanna thank me, you can find me @ribelle0804 on twitter, plz support my ship. It[/font]’[font=Calibri]s basically the most important stuff in my life.[/font]
